mission: Our mission is to empower students at Lake Norman High School to develop the leadership, business, technology, and professional skills needed to succeed in college, careers, and their communities. Through hands-on experiences, competitive events, community service, and collaboration, FBLA provides students with opportunities to turn their interests and ideas into real-world skills.
reasons: We believe students learn best when they have opportunities to apply what they learn in the classroom to real situations. FBLA allows members to explore careers in business, finance, entrepreneurship, cybersecurity, marketing, technology, and other fields while building skills that extend beyond academics.
